_doc: POIs OSM does not have yet, merged into the OSM extract by build_streetlife.py (load_raw). Each needs a source; positions from the UrbIS address point (CC0), never traced from imagery. Add them to OSM when confirmed and drop them here.

elements._source: Owner (lives in Uccle): 'the white night shop on Place Saint-Job'; name, number 662 and photos of the front on its Google listing (looked at 2026-11-16, not kept; a review two weeks old: OPEN). Street View Jul 2024: the shop is the LOW one-storey wing of n. 662 (UrbIS solid 541080, eaves 3.5 m), set back from the street behind trees, its front facing the paved lot to the east (a EuroMillions feather flag); the 662 house itself has Bioffice. Position: a point 1 m out from that wing's lot-side wall (DSM: the 3.5-3.9 m block), local (1060.9, 531.3)

Le Relais Saint-Job, traiteur & vins (2-storey white corner, Place de Saint-Job 3): reference photo of the front (privateaser.com/lieu/57030, looked at, not kept) + UrbIS footprints 544703 / 559047; Brasserie at Place de Saint-Job 1 (listings: privateaser.com/lieu/57030, tripaligner, mapstr

Le Relais Saint-Job, brasserie (the low white house with the tiled roof, n. 1): reference photo of the front (privateaser.com/lieu/57030, looked at, not kept) + UrbIS footprints 544703 / 559047; Brasserie at Place de Saint-Job 1 (listings: privateaser.com/lieu/57030, tripaligner, mapstr

Le Relais Saint-Job, restaurant + the terrace (n. 1, north end): reference photo of the front (privateaser.com/lieu/57030, looked at, not kept) + UrbIS footprints 544703 / 559047; Brasserie at Place de Saint-Job 1 (listings: privateaser.com/lieu/57030, tripaligner, mapstr

Street View Jul 2024 (looked at): the newsagent (red fascia, white script, Lotto) right of the Deneubourg bakery at n. 36, where OSM still has Barat (closed: the bakery at 36 is Deneubourg). Drop OSM n4361797887 (Barat) in the builder: _replaces
Street View Jul 2024 (looked at, not kept): Bois Savanes, restaurant thaï traiteur, Place de Saint-Job 24; position = UrbIS address 24
Street View Jul 2024 (looked at, not kept): Funérailles - Begrafenissen Lefevre, Place de Saint-Job 23; position = UrbIS address 23

Street View Jul 2024 (looked at, not kept): the ground floor of n. 662 (navy fascia, white lettering); vrac&compagnie there is permanently closed (Google listing 2026-11-16): OSM n10282874852 dropped; position = the old vrac&compagnie point (OSM n10282874852, on the 662 front)
Street View Jul 2024 (papered window 'Le Palais de la Truffe, ouverture prochaine'); open now (Google listing, 83 reviews, 2026-11-16); position = UrbIS address 27
Street View Jul 2024 (looked at, not kept): CANON (bières locales) on a black fascia, Place de Saint-Job 26; position = UrbIS address 26. TO CONFIRM it is a bar (the sign says local beers)

Street View Oct 2020 (newest there; looked at, not kept): the vet's CABINET VÉTÉRINAIRE panel is on the red-brick house LEFT of Le Relais' corner, facing the Place (as Le Relais); OSM's point put it on the building's side facing the lawn. Moved 1 m out from that front (local 1102.2, 553.6)

claude/places1 (owner: 'Chaussée de Saint-Job night shop and Brico Job opposite it'): Google Maps listing 'Agam nightshop', Sint-Jobsesteenweg 701 (looked at 2026-11-23, not kept); Street View Apr 2024: the white-painted two-storey corner house on the path beside n. 699, a red fascia board 'NIGHT SHOP' in white capitals over the ground floor with a white line of goods under it, black barred windows and door, a black plinth. Position: the UrbIS address point of n. 701 (CC0), local (864.36, 673.14)

claude/places1: Google Maps listing 'Brico Sint-Job', Sint-Jobsesteenweg 594 (looked at 2026-11-23, not kept); Street View Apr 2024: a low anthracite metal-clad shed set back behind its own car park, the yellow Brico logo letters over the glazed entrance on a grey fascia, garden goods outside. Position: the UrbIS address point of n. 594 (CC0), local (876.67, 643.47)

claude/places2 (owner playtest: 'Le Pigeon Noir: entrance on the wrong side'): Street View Apr 2024 (looked at, not kept): the restaurant's door, its navy awning with LE PIGEON NOIR in white and its windows are on the house's NORTH face, on Rue Geleytsbeek (its address, Rue Geleytsbeek 2: the UrbIS address point of building 1713722 faces that street); the east gable on Avenue de la Chênaie only carries a pigeon emblem plaque. OSM's point has no addr:street, so the façade attach took the nearest wall (the Chênaie gable). Moved 1 m out from the north face, 5 m along it from its west end (local -90.6, 775.9), with the address
